text:
nora: Follow-up from Minotaur postmortem. Root cause: peering route acceptance race + on-prem edge appliance that drops reordered packets and aggressively clears conntrack. Resulted in partial isolation for Dedicated customer prefixes. Need owners, timelines, and quick detection.

dilip: I'll own the peering-side fixes. Plan: add a staged-acceptance window so we don't mass-apply routes while a peer is flapping; also add sequence checks to peering-agent. ETA 4d.

ada: I'll handle on-prem remediation guidance. Will request vendor firmware/known-issues, propose conntrack tuning and sample keepalive rules. If vendor patch delayed, document fallback app keepalive and per-customer opt-in. ETA 3d for draft.

nora: Ops asks: 1) passive alert when a peer shows >3 state transitions in 5m, 2) historical attach of similar incidents for runbook.

ops-bot: Created epic MIN-PEER-101 -> https://issues.internal/MIN-PEER-101 :spiral_calendar:

dilip: Repro commands I'm using: ```bash
kubectl logs peering-agent -n infra --tail=500 > /tmp/min-peers.log
aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-min123
```

nora: Short action tracker:
- [ ] Owner: dilip - staged-route-accept + unit tests + PR (due 2026-04-01) - PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/peering/pulls/1309
- [ ] Owner: ada - vendor contact + conntrack recommendation + fallback keepalive doc (due 2026-03-30) - TICKET: NET-8010
- [ ] Owner: nora - alert: peer-flap-rate & incident history attach to MIN-PEER-101 (due 2026-04-03)

ada: If customer won't allow conntrack changes, we should offer a traffic-proxy shim as a stopgap (low-risk). I'll include cost/ops notes.

dilip: I'll add a harness to replay peer state logs and simulate reordered packets; will include a flag to vary flap cadence.

incident-bot: Reminder: link PRs/tickets to INC-10021 for auditability.

nora: Scheduling 15m sync Thu 09:00 PT to close blockers. Post updates here if you can't make it. Thanks all. :memo:
